name: algorithmic-prompting
description: Partition work into architecture lanes, show dependency topology in conversation, and navigate large plans through clickable task files.

interface.shortDescription: Plan parallel worktrees and draft bounded agent prompts.
interface.longDescription: Partition implementation goals into architecture lanes such as API, WEB, and SDK; show a compact Mermaid dependency topology in conversation; draft a coding-agent prompt for every subtask; navigate large plans through clickable temporary Markdown files; distinguish hard prerequisites from merge risks; and advance ready work through human-approved Kahn scheduling.
interface.defaultPrompt: Partition this goal into architecture lanes, show a compact Mermaid dependency graph in conversation, draft a coding-agent prompt for every subtask, and propose the next human-approved parallel worktree batch.
